title: All in the family: Arch Manning looks for bragging rights over Peyton in Texas-Tennessee

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: All in the family: Arch Manning looks for bragging rights over Peyton in Texas-Tennessee
sources.description: Arch Manning looks to lead No. 1 Texas to a Week 4 win on the road on Saturday at his uncle, Peyton Manning's alma mater: Tennessee. Here's more.
